## Matching decompilations and disassemblies

- [**3S Decomp: a byte-compared PS2 decompilation of Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike**](https://github.com/crowded-street/3s-decomp) - Decompiles the PlayStation 2 executable of Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike from Street Fighter Anniversary Collection into C that period Metrowerks and EE GCC compilers rebuild, then compares the rebuilt executable word by word with the user’s original. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/sfiii-3rd-strike-ps2-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Agent decompilation: a byte-matching retrospective**](https://momo5502.com/posts/2026-10-09-game-decompilation/) - Maurice Heumann describes replacing plausible-looking agent output with compiler-based checks of reconstructed functions, relocations, data and types. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/agent-decompilation-oracle-case/)</sub>
- [**Animal Crossing: matching GameCube decompilation**](https://github.com/ACreTeam/ac-decomp) - Reconstructs Animal Crossing’s GameCube code as C and C++ source that rebuilds the USA release’s main executable and its foresta.rel module. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/animal-crossing-gamecube-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Animal Crossing: Wild World: matching Korean DS decompilation with differential runtime checks**](https://github.com/banatic/acww-decomp) - Reconstructs the ARM9 game code of Animal Crossing: Wild World’s Korean DS release as one C or C++ source per function, checked against the user’s ROM with the original Metrowerks compiler and linker. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/animal-crossing-wild-world-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Animal Forest: an in-progress matching N64 decompilation**](https://github.com/zeldaret/af) - Rebuilds the Japanese Nintendo 64 release of Animal Forest (Dōbutsu no Mori) from C code reverse-engineered from the ROM, combined with assets and assembly extracted from a user-supplied ROM. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/animal-forest-n64-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**BFM-decomp: Brave Fencer Musashi matching decompilation**](https://github.com/Druthulu/BFM-decomp) - Documents an agent-assisted reconstruction of the USA PlayStation game with a pinned compiler and whole-binary SHA-1 gates. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/bfm-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Breath of the Wild: per-function matching decompilation of the Switch executable**](https://github.com/zeldaret/botw) - Reimplements part of Breath of the Wild’s Switch v1.5.0 main executable in C++ and checks each function against the original machine code. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/botw-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Castlevania: Symphony of the Night: matching decompilation across PlayStation, PSP and Saturn builds**](https://github.com/Xeeynamo/sotn-decomp) - Recreates C source for Castlevania: Symphony of the Night from its PlayStation, PSP and Saturn binaries, aiming for code that compiles byte for byte to the original game files. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/sotn-matching-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Crackdown 2: byte-matched Xbox 360 decompilation**](https://github.com/matty45/Crackdown2-Decomp) - Crackdown2-Decomp reconstructs C++ source for the Xbox 360 title-update build of Crackdown 2. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/crackdown-2-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Doraemon: a byte-identical Famicom source reconstruction**](https://github.com/RetrolariumLab/doraemon_src) - Doraemon reconstructs the Japanese release of Hudson Soft's 1986 Famicom game as ca65 assembly source. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/doraemon-nes-source-reconstruction-case/)</sub>
- [**Downhill Revived: a matching decompilation and PC port of Downhill Domination**](https://github.com/skuza-oss/downhill-revived) - Downhill Revived ports the PlayStation 2 game Downhill Domination to native 64-bit Windows using C/C++ source matched byte for byte to the original game program. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/downhill-revived-case/)</sub>
- [**Dragon Ball Z: L'Appel du Destin: rebuilding the Mega Drive ROM from source**](https://github.com/consolesplayingconsoles/dbzbr-disasm) - Dragon Ball Z: L'Appel du Destin disassembly reconstructs the French Mega Drive ROM as generated assembly and compares it byte for byte with a user-provided original. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/dbzbr-disasm-case/)</sub>
- [**Driver 1 decomp: matching Driver and porting it to Linux**](https://github.com/olink9/driver1-decomp) - Driver 1 decomp reconstructs Driver: You Are the Wheelman for PlayStation in C while retaining original hand-written assembly routines, and compares rebuilt code with the original executable and overlays. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/driver-1-decomp-case/)</sub>

- [**GoldenEye 007: matching Nintendo 64 decompilation for three releases**](https://github.com/n64decomp/007) - Reconstructs GoldenEye 007’s Nintendo 64 code as C source that rebuilds the US, Japanese and PAL ROMs. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/goldeneye-007-matching-decomp-case/)</sub>

- [**Sonic Advance 3: an AI-assisted match of one enemy module**](https://gambiconf.substack.com/p/development-journey-on-game-decompilation) - Macabeus’s dated study describes prompting Claude Sonnet 3.5 and DeepSeek R1 with assembly, similar decompiled functions and structs to write matching C for Marun, one enemy module of the community Sonic Advance 3 GBA decompilation. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/sa3-marun-ai-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Sonic Adventure decomp: rebuilding the Dreamcast executable from a local disc**](https://github.com/consolesplayingconsoles/sonic-adventure-decomp) - Sonic Adventure decomp reconstructs the European Dreamcast game's executable from a user-supplied disc, using per-function SH-4 assembly files as a byte-matching build baseline. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/sonic-adventure-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Sonic the Hedgehog 2: byte-identical REV00 and REV01 source reconstruction**](https://github.com/RetrolariumLab/sonic2_src) - The Sonic the Hedgehog 2 Source Reconstruction extends Sonic Retro's disassembly into shared 68000 and Z80 source for retail REV00 and REV01. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/sonic-the-hedgehog-2-source-reconstruction-case/)</sub>
- [**Splashdown: a matching PS2 decompilation and Linux port**](https://github.com/CoastRedWood/splashdown) - Splashdown reconstructs C++ source for the NTSC-U PlayStation 2 game and builds a native Linux x86-64 port from it. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/splashdown-case/)</sub>
- [**Star Fox 64: a complete matching Nintendo 64 decompilation**](https://github.com/sonicdcer/sf64) - Reconstructs C source for the US 1.1 (Rev A) Nintendo 64 release of Star Fox 64 that, compiled with the IDO compiler through a static recompilation, rebuilds a ROM with the published MD5; the README badge counts all 2,951 functions as matching. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/sf64-matching-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Super Mario 64 DS: matching decompilation with relocation checks**](https://github.com/tangosdev/sm64ds-decomp) - Reconstructs Super Mario 64 DS functions as C/C++ and permitted assembly primitives, comparing compiled output with a user-supplied cartridge dump. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/sm64ds-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Super Mario 64: ROM reconstruction with explicit comparison gates**](https://github.com/n64decomp/sm64) - Reconstructs Super Mario 64 source for Japanese, North American, European, Shindou and iQue releases. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/sm64-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Super Mario Bros.: ca65 reconstruction of seven releases**](https://github.com/RetrolariumLab/smb1_src) - Super Mario Bros. Disassembly reconstructs seven NES, Vs. System, and Famicom Disk System releases as readable ca65 modules. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/super-mario-bros-disassembly-case/)</sub>
- [**Super Mario Odyssey: per-function matching decompilation of the Switch executable**](https://github.com/MonsterDruide1/OdysseyDecomp) - Reconstructs C++ source for Super Mario Odyssey’s Switch 1.0 main executable and checks each function against the original AArch64 machine code with the shared nx-decomp-tools checker. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/odyssey-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Super Mario Sunshine (USA): an AI-assisted matching decompilation fork**](https://github.com/chasem-dev/sms-english) - Extends the doldecomp Super Mario Sunshine decompilation to the North American GMSE01 release. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/sms-english-gmse01-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Super Mario Sunshine: an in-progress matching GameCube decompilation**](https://github.com/doldecomp/sms) - Reconstructs Super Mario Sunshine’s C++ source so that the original Metrowerks compiler reproduces byte-identical object files for four GameCube releases and the Switch 3D All-Stars build. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/sms-matching-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Super Smash Bros. Brawl: an early matching Wii decompilation**](https://github.com/doldecomp/brawl) - A work-in-progress matching decompilation of Super Smash Bros. Brawl that targets the USA Rev 2 Wii release (RSBE01\_02), splitting main.dol and 126 REL modules from a user-supplied disc image and checking the rebuilt binaries against stored SHA-1 values. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/smash-bros-brawl-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Super Smash Bros. Melee: a matching GameCube decompilation with a shiftable build**](https://github.com/doldecomp/melee) - A matching decompilation of Super Smash Bros. Melee's US 1.02 release (GALE01) that rebuilds main.dol from C with the original Metrowerks compilers and checks it against the retail SHA-1. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/melee-matching-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Syphon Filter: The Omega Strain — matching PS2 executable decompilation**](https://github.com/zm2283145/syphon-filter-omega-strain-decomp) - Reconstructs much of the NTSC-U PlayStation 2 executable of Syphon Filter: The Omega Strain as C; with the remaining functions kept as split assembly, the build reproduces the retail SCUS\_972.64 byte for byte. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/syphon-filter-omega-strain-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**TH04: rebuilding Lotus Land Story’s four PC-98 programs from source**](https://github.com/N0zoM1z0/th04) - Reconstructs source for the Japanese PC-98 Touhou 4: Lotus Land Story and rebuilds all four DOS programs, MAIN.EXE, OP.EXE, MAINE.EXE and ZUN.COM, with a pinned Borland toolchain under Wine. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/th04-reconstruction-case/)</sub>
- [**TH05: reconstructing Touhou 5's PC-98 programs**](https://github.com/N0zoM1z0/th05) - TH05 reconstructs source for the Japanese PC-98 Touhou 5: Mystic Square programs MAIN.EXE, OP.EXE, MAINE.EXE and ZUN.COM. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/th05-reconstruction-case/)</sub>
- [**th06: an independently matching Touhou 6 decompilation**](https://github.com/Cirno-Labs/th06) - th06 reconstructs C++ source for Touhou 6: Embodiment of Scarlet Devil retail version 1.02h from the original executable. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/cirno-labs-th06-case/)</sub>
- [**TH06: reconstructing Japanese 1.02h authored functions**](https://github.com/N0zoM1z0/th06) - TH06 reconstructs the Japanese 1.02h game executable using a maintained source tree based on GensokyoClub/th06 and a pinned VC7.0 build. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/th06-strict-reconstruction-case/)</sub>
- [**th07: reconstructing Touhou 7 retail 1.00b**](https://github.com/Cirno-Labs/th07) - th07 reconstructs C++ for the retail 1.00b executable of Touhou 7: Perfect Cherry Blossom using Ghidra analysis, the original Visual C++ .NET 2002 toolchain and byte comparisons against a user supplied game copy. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/cirno-th07-case/)</sub>
- [**TH08: exact-source reconstruction and separately tested ports**](https://github.com/N0zoM1z0/th08) - Reconstructs the original Japanese Touhou 8 version 1.00d against its binary and original compiler, then adapts the recovered code for other platforms. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/th08-reconstruction-case/)</sub>
- [**TH095: function-level reconstruction of Shoot the Bullet 1.02a**](https://github.com/N0zoM1z0/th095) - Reconstructs source for the original Japanese Touhou 9.5: Shoot the Bullet 1.02a executable, accepting function exactness only through reproducible byte comparison of pinned Visual C++ .NET 2003 builds against one hash-attested target. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/th095-reconstruction-case/)</sub>
- [**TH11: byte-exact source reconstruction of Subterranean Animism**](https://github.com/N0zoM1z0/th11) - TH11 reconstructs source for the original Japanese 1.00a executable of Touhou 11: Subterranean Animism. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/th11-reconstruction-case/)</sub>
- [**The Minish Cap: a GBA decompilation targeting five ROMs**](https://github.com/zeldaret/tmc) - Recreates a C source base for The Legend of Zelda: The Minish Cap from information in the game and static or dynamic analysis, building five Game Boy Advance ROMs: USA, EU, JP and two demos. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/zelda-tmc-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**The Sims: Bustin' Out: an AI-driven partial GBA matching decompilation**](https://github.com/DaBrown95/tsbodp) - Rebuilds the USA/Europe Game Boy Advance release of The Sims: Bustin' Out byte for byte while gradually replacing ROM regions with matching C compiled by agbcc. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/sims-bustin-out-gba-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**The Wind Waker: a GameCube decompilation with hash-checked relinking**](https://github.com/zeldaret/tww) - Reconstructs source for The Wind Waker’s GameCube executable and REL modules across the USA/Korea, PAL and Japanese releases and a Japanese kiosk demo. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/wind-waker-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Thrasher: Skate and Destroy: a matching PlayStation decompilation**](https://github.com/andrewnakas/thrasher-skate-decomp) - Thrasher: Skate and Destroy is being reconstructed function by function as C for its US PlayStation executable. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/thrasher-skate-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Tom and Jerry Tales: matching decompilation of the EU Nintendo DS game**](https://github.com/liolu/tom-and-jerry-tales-decomp) - Tom and Jerry Tales reconstructs C source for the EU Nintendo DS game with Metrowerks mwccarm. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/tom-and-jerry-tales-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Top Spin 4 decompilation: matching Xbox 360 functions against three XEX modules**](https://github.com/g-guthrie/topspin4-decomp) - Top Spin 4 decompilation reconstructs C source for the Xbox 360 game and compares compiled functions against code in three retail XEX modules. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/top-spin-4-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Touhou 6: reconstructing Embodiment of Scarlet Devil 1.02h source**](https://github.com/GensokyoClub/th06) - Reconstructs C++ source for the Windows executable of Touhou 6: Embodiment of Scarlet Devil version 1.02h, aiming at an exact rebuild with the original Visual Studio .NET 2002 and DirectX 8 toolchain. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/th06-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Touhou 7: reconstructing Perfect Cherry Blossom 1.00b source**](https://github.com/some100/th07) - Reconstructs C++ source for the Windows executable of Touhou 7: Perfect Cherry Blossom 1.00b and its custom.exe configuration tool, built with the original Visual Studio .NET 2002 and DirectX 8 toolchain and compared function by function with the user’s originals through reccmp. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/th07-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Touhou 8: an independent matching decompilation of Imperishable Night**](https://github.com/Cirno-Labs/th08) - Cirno-Labs/th08 reconstructs Touhou 8: Imperishable Night retail 1.00d in C++ and checks the build against the user's original game. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/cirno-labs-th08-case/)</sub>
- [**Toy Story disassembly: rebuilding the Mega Drive ROM from generated source**](https://github.com/consolesplayingconsoles/toy-story-disasm) - Toy Story disassembly reconstructs the Mega Drive game's ROM as generated assembly source and compares the rebuilt ROM byte for byte with the user's copy. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/toy-story-mega-drive-disasm-case/)</sub>
- [**Twilight Princess: a decompilation with fully matching GameCube code**](https://github.com/zeldaret/tp) - Reconstructs Twilight Princess source that compiles back to binaries identical to the originals, building GameCube, Wii and Nvidia Shield releases from one codebase through conditional compilation. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/twilight-princess-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Underworld Exhumed: reconstructing Ultima Underworld I and II**](https://github.com/abedegno/underworld-exhumed) - Pairs reconstructed DOS sources with native ports of Ultima Underworld I and II. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/underworld-exhumed-case/)</sub>
- [**WCW Nitro: a checksum-checked PlayStation decompilation**](https://github.com/martinbean/nitro) - WCW Nitro is a PlayStation game decompilation that rebuilds code from the SLUS\_003.97 executable and WGAME.BIN and WMENU.BIN overlays. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/wcw-nitro-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**wii-ipl: a decompilation of the Wii Menu (System Menu 4.3)**](https://github.com/koopthekoopa/wii-ipl) - A work-in-progress decompilation of the Wii Menu, the console’s System Menu (IPL), targeting version 4.3 in its USA, European, Japanese and Korean builds. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Firmware · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/wii-menu-ipl-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**xmen2-pc: a matching decompilation and native port of X-Men 2: Clone Wars**](https://github.com/crabsmack/xmen2-pc) - xmen2-pc reconstructs X-Men 2: Clone Wars as handwritten C and ports it to Windows and Linux without 68000 emulation. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/xmen2-pc-case/)</sub>
- [**xmen2disasm: rebuilding X-Men 2 from a matching disassembly**](https://github.com/crabsmack/xmen2disasm) - xmen2disasm reconstructs the Sega Genesis game X-Men 2: Clone Wars as a byte-matching 68000 disassembly. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/xmen2disasm-case/)</sub>
- [**Zelda: The Wand of Gamelon: a matching CD-i decompilation**](https://github.com/ByteDecompiler/zelda-wand-of-gamelon) - Zelda: The Wand of Gamelon's CD-i main program is reconstructed as C compiled with Apple MPW C 3.0. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/zelda-wand-of-gamelon-decomp-case/)</sub>

## Non-matching decompilations

- [**Bumpy's Arcade Fantasy: reconstructing a DOS game in C**](https://github.com/GeReV/bumpy-reverse) - Bumpy's Arcade Fantasy reconstructs the 1992 DOS game's engine as C source guided by Ghidra analysis. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/bumpys-arcade-fantasy-decomp-case/)</sub>

Raymond’s terminal port of Firefighter, Eben Sprinsock’s 1985 DOS shareware game. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/firefighter-rust-port-case/)</sub>

- [**Metroid Dread: a hand decompilation in progress**](https://github.com/tsuyoi-w/DreadComp) - DreadComp is an in-progress hand decompilation of Metroid Dread that recreates game source code in C++. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/dreadcomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Need for Speed: Porsche Unleashed: differential x86 source recovery**](https://github.com/xfynx/prsche-disasm) - prsche-disasm recovers C/C++ source for Need for Speed: Porsche Unleashed from its Windows x86 binaries. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/nfs-porsche-unleashed-recovery-case/)</sub>
- [**nfsu2\_decomp: a native reconstruction of Need for Speed: Underground 2**](https://github.com/mad0xStrixhadorami/nfsu2-native) - nfsu2\_decomp rewrites logic from the PS2 PAL release of Need for Speed: Underground 2 as native Linux C++ and uses the user's disc data at runtime. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/nfsu2-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**OpenGOAL: recovering GOAL code and rebuilding the Jak games**](https://github.com/open-goal/jak-project) - Reconstructs readable GOAL code from the original Jak binaries and compiles it with a new GOAL compiler for modern PCs. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/opengoal-jak-case/)</sub>

- [**R.E.L.I.V.E.: an Oddworld Abe’s Oddysee and Abe’s Exoddus engine reimplementation**](https://github.com/AliveTeam/alive_reversing) - Reimplements the engine of Oddworld: Abe’s Oddysee and Abe’s Exoddus as an open-source replacement executable that runs from the user’s own game folder. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/relive-oddworld-abe-engine-case/)</sub>

- [**REFLEC BEAT plus: reconstructed iOS game source**](https://github.com/Tatsh/expert-xylophone) - REFLEC BEAT plus reconstructs Objective-C and C++ source for version 4.5.8 of the iOS rhythm game. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/reflec-beat-plus-source-case/)</sub>

- [**RSDKv4 Decompilation: Retro Engine v4 and the Sonic 1 &amp; 2 (2013) menus**](https://github.com/RSDKModding/RSDKv4-Decompilation) - Decompiles Retro Engine (RSDK) v4, the engine behind Sonic the Hedgehog and Sonic the Hedgehog 2 (2013), together with the games’ natively coded menus, and builds it for Windows, Linux and Android. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/rsdkv4-sonic-1-2-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**RSDKv5 Decompilation: reconstructing Retro Engine v5 and v5U**](https://github.com/RSDKModding/RSDKv5-Decompilation) - Reconstructs the Retro Engine (RSDK) v5 and v5 Ultimate runtime, the engine that runs Sonic Mania’s game code, and builds it for Windows, Linux, Switch and Android. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/rsdkv5-engine-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Sonic Mania: a game-code decompilation for the RSDKv5 engine**](https://github.com/RSDKModding/Sonic-Mania-Decompilation) - Reconstructs Sonic Mania’s game code in C and builds it with the separately decompiled RSDKv5 or RSDKv5U engine for Windows, Linux, Switch and Android. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/sonic-mania-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**SpaceCadetPinball: decompiled game logic adapted to SDL2**](https://github.com/k4zmu2a/SpaceCadetPinball) - Converts the reverse-engineered Space Cadet pinball game into compilable C++ for desktop platforms. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/space-cadet-pinball-case/)</sub>

- [**vf2-decomp: differentially validated Virtua Fighter 2 recovery**](https://github.com/celsowm/vf2-decomp) - Recovers Virtua Fighter 2 Version 2.1’s Sega Model 2A i960 program into portable, non-matching C17, accepting each recovered path only when it matches a reference i960 executor at controlled boundaries. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/vf2-decomp-differential-recovery-case/)</sub>
- [**WCW/nWo Thunder: a PlayStation decompilation**](https://github.com/martinbean/thunder) - WCW/nWo Thunder reconstructs source for the PlayStation game from a work-in-progress disassembly. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/wcw-nwo-thunder-case/)</sub>
- [**Wind Waker HD decompilation: functions verified against the recompiled Wii U game**](https://github.com/ZeldaWWHDDecomp/wwhd) - Decompiles the USA Wii U release of The Wind Waker HD function by function into readable C++ in zeldaret/tww’s style, and verifies each function by running it beside the original, statically recompiled from the user’s own copy, comparing return values, memory writes and calls on generated and recorded inputs, with coverage and mutation checks. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/wind-waker-hd-decomp-case/)</sub>

- [**Project Arwing: Star Fox recompiled from a matching disassembly**](https://github.com/carlosrmz009/arwing) - Disassembles Star Fox’s 65816 and SuperFX code from runtime coverage and recursive descent, reassembles it into the original ROM, then translates it statically to C on a from-scratch SNES runtime for Windows, macOS and Linux. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/project-arwing-star-fox-recomp-case/)</sub>

- [**Snap64 Recomp: a static-recompilation port of Pokémon Snap**](https://github.com/JackandBeans/Snap64Recomp) - Uses N64Recomp to statically recompile the US Nintendo 64 release of Pokémon Snap into a native Windows, Linux, Steam Deck and macOS port rendered with RT64. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/snap64-recomp-case/)</sub>

- [**Unleashed Recompiled: translating Xbox 360 game code and shaders**](https://github.com/hedge-dev/UnleashedRecomp) - Builds an unofficial Sonic Unleashed PC port by statically recompiling Xbox 360 PowerPC code with XenonRecomp and Xenos shaders with XenosRecomp. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/unleashed-recompiled-case/)</sub>

## Ports of reconstructed source

- [**2 Ship 2 Harkinian: a native Majora’s Mask port built on the decompilation**](https://github.com/2ship2harkinian/2ship2harkinian) - Builds native Windows, Linux and macOS versions of The Legend of Zelda: Majora’s Mask from an adapted copy of the zeldaret/mm decompilation, with libultraship reimplementing N64 SDK functions. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/2ship2harkinian-mm-port-case/)</sub>
- [**358/2 Days for Android: porting Kingdom Hearts to dual-screen devices**](https://github.com/sonofskywalker3/khdays-358-android) - 358/2 Days for Android ports Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days to Android using the upstream khdays-port and its decompiled C game code. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/khdays-358-android-case/)</sub>
- [**3SX: a native Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike port continuing the PS2 decompilation**](https://github.com/crowded-street/3sx) - Builds Street Fighter III: 3rd Strike as native C for Windows, macOS and Linux, continuing the 3s-decomp PS2 decompilation, with SDL3 for video, input and audio and GekkoNet for rollback netplay. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/3sx-third-strike-native-port-case/)</sub>
- [**9mm Vita: rehosting 9mm HD Android on PS Vita**](https://github.com/iwannagooutside/9mm-vita) - 9mm Vita ports 9mm HD Android to PS Vita by loading the user's ARMv7 game executable into memory. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/9mm-vita-case/)</sub>
- [**Animal Crossing: a native PC port of the GameCube decompilation**](https://github.com/flyngmt/ACGC-PC-Port) - Runs Animal Crossing’s decompiled GameCube C code natively on 32-bit x86, replacing the GX graphics API with an OpenGL 3.3 translation layer and console services with SDL2-based platform code. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/animal-crossing-pc-port-case/)</sub>
- [**Atlantis Native: porting the Atlantis and Atlantis II engines to Rust**](https://github.com/ripleyXLR8/atlantis-native) - Atlantis Native ports the reverse-engineered CryOmni3D Atlantis engine to Rust for Atlantis: The Lost Tales and Atlantis II. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/atlantis-native-case/)</sub>
- [**BattleShip: an AI-assisted Super Smash Bros. native port**](https://github.com/JRickey/BattleShip) - Ports the existing Super Smash Bros. N64 decompilation using libultraship and Torch. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/battleship-port-case/)</sub>
- [**Boulder Dash: an NES disassembly and C/SDL2 port**](https://github.com/Kryyto/boulder-dash-nes-decomp) - Boulder Dash reconstructs an annotated disassembly of the USA NES game and translates its routines into a native C11 and SDL2 port. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/boulder-dash-nes-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Budokai Tenkaichi 3: a native PC port built on a matching decompilation**](https://github.com/z3xox/Tenkaichi3Decomp) - Compiles the decompiled code of Dragon Ball Z: Budokai Tenkaichi 3 (PS2, USA release SLUS-21678) for PC on a new renderer, sound, input and platform layer rather than an emulator. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/tenkaichi3-pc-port-case/)</sub>
- [**Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse: a paused native Apple Silicon port**](https://github.com/slavich33/castlevania-belmonts-curse-native) - Castlevania: Belmont’s Curse native preserves a paused Apple Silicon port adaptation of the game. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/castlevania-belmonts-curse-native-case/)</sub>
- [**Cosmo: a native port of Cosmo's Cosmic Adventure**](https://github.com/digows/cosmo) - Cosmo ports the reconstructed source of Cosmo's Cosmic Adventure: Forbidden Planet to macOS, Linux and Windows. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/cosmo-native-port-case/)</sub>
- [**CTR Turbocharged: a PC sourceport built on the Crash Team Racing decompilation**](https://github.com/CameronRedmore/Crash-Team-Racing-Turbocharged) - Extends the Crash Team Racing: High Octane sourceport, which derives from the CTR Native port of the CTR-ModSDK PlayStation decompilation, into Windows and Linux builds with a native 3D renderer, selectable aspect ratios and frame rates up to 240 FPS. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/ctr-turbocharged-port-case/)</sub>
- [**d2mac-linux: porting the Diablo II Mac executable to 32-bit Linux**](https://github.com/jaenster/d2mac-linux) - d2mac-linux ports the Diablo II 1.14d Mac executable to 32-bit Linux by converting its i386 Mach-O container to ELF and reimplementing imported Darwin, Carbon and AGL interfaces in Zig. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/d2mac-linux-case/)</sub>

- [**Destruction Derby 2: portable C port of the PlayStation game**](https://github.com/wardboumans/dd2-psx-decomp) - Destruction Derby 2 is ported from its USA PlayStation executable and overlays into portable C11 using SDL3. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/destruction-derby-2-port-case/)</sub>

- [**DiabloWeb: a WebAssembly browser port built on Devilution**](https://github.com/d07RiV/diabloweb) - Runs Diablo in web browsers by compiling a stripped-down fork of Devilution, the community reconstruction of the game’s original source, to WebAssembly behind a React front end. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/diabloweb-devilution-wasm-port-case/)</sub>
- [**Drift City Rebuild: a Unity client and server from game analysis**](https://github.com/MagicIbrar/driftcity-unity) - Drift City Rebuild rebuilds the online racing game as a Unity client that reads data from the user's installed copy, with a new Node.js server for offline or hosted play. <sub>Case study · Mixed workflow · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/driftcity-unity-case/)</sub>

- [**geow2: a native Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 port**](https://github.com/techknight/geow2) - geow2 rebuilds Geometry Wars: Retro Evolved 2 as a native Windows, macOS, and Linux game based on analysis of the Xbox 360 executable. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/geow2-case/)</sub>
- [**Ghostship: a libultraship native port of Super Mario 64**](https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Ghostship) - Builds Super Mario 64 as a native PC, Switch and Android program by compiling decompilation-style game source against the libultraship platform library. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/ghostship-sm64-port-case/)</sub>
- [**GoldenEye 007: an agent-assisted native port from a decompilation**](https://github.com/jkdansereau/goldeneye-pc-port) - Builds a native PC port on the existing GoldenEye 007 decompilation, with a host platform layer and assets extracted from the user’s ROM. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/goldeneye-pc-port-case/)</sub>
- [**ico-pc: a native ICO port compiled from the PS2 decompilation**](https://github.com/nathanialf/ico-pc) - Compiles the decompiled C of the PlayStation 2 game ICO natively for Windows, Linux, Android, iPhone and Apple-silicon Macs, with host code standing in for the PS2 hardware and Sony libraries. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/ico-pc-port-case/)</sub>
- [**Ignition: porting the 1997 racing game from executable analysis**](https://github.com/xesf/ignition) - Ignition ports the 1997 racing game by reading routines in its Windows executable with IDA and rewriting their behaviour in portable C99. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/ignition-port-case/)</sub>
- [**jgalbs cod4: porting the Call of Duty 4 multiplayer client to Apple Silicon**](https://github.com/JGalbss/cod4-macos) - jgalbs cod4 ports the KisakCOD Call of Duty 4 multiplayer client to Apple Silicon macOS. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/jgalbs-cod4-case/)</sub>
- [**Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days: native PC port built on a matching decompilation**](https://github.com/Yokimitsuro/khdays-port) - Compiles the C of the khdays-decomp matching decompilation for Windows x64 and supplies a native platform layer for the Nintendo DS hardware, SDK services and sound driver. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/khdays-native-pc-port-case/)</sub>
- [**LEGO Island, portable: a multi-platform port of the decompiled source**](https://github.com/isledecomp/isle-portable) - Adapts the LEGO Island decompilation into a portable build for desktop, mobile, console, DOS and Web targets. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/lego-island-portable-case/)</sub>
- [**Lighthouse: a Banjo-Kazooie PC port built on the decompilation**](https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Lighthouse) - A native Windows, Linux and macOS port of Banjo-Kazooie that compiles game C sources, many tagged with their Banjo-Kazooie decompilation file paths, against libultraship, a reimplementation of the N64 SDK. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/lighthouse-banjo-kazooie-port-case/)</sub>
- [**LineWars II: a portable SDL3 reconstruction**](https://github.com/fredangstadt-lang/LineWarsII-SDL) - Provides an SDL3 backend for a portable-C reconstruction of the 1994 DOS game. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/linewars-ii-sdl-case/)</sub>
- [**Link: The Faces of Evil — a native PC port of the CD-i decompilation**](https://github.com/ByteDecompiler/link-faces-of-evil-pc) - A native Windows port of Link: The Faces of Evil runs C code from the Philips CD-i game decompilation and replaces CD-i video, audio, disc and input services with an SDL3 host. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/link-faces-of-evil-pc-case/)</sub>
- [**MDK in Godot: a port from game data and executable analysis**](https://github.com/nautilusbits/mdk-godot) - MDK in Godot ports the 1997 game MDK to Godot 4.7 using analysis of its data files and MDKD3D.EXE. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/mdk-godot-case/)</sub>

- [**Metroid Prime Port: an AI-assisted native port of the PrimeDecomp decompilation**](https://github.com/Odrannnn/MetroidPrimePort) - Compiles the PrimeDecomp decompilation of Metroid Prime’s game and engine code as native C++20 for Linux, Windows and Android, with an experimental macOS build. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/metroid-prime-port-case/)</sub>
- [**Metropolismania PC: porting a PS2 game function by function**](https://github.com/koaque/Metropolismania-PC) - Metropolismania PC rebuilds the PS2 game as readable C++ while using PS2Recomp output from the user's disc as a running scaffold. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/metropolismania-pc-case/)</sub>
- [**MikuPan: a native Fatal Frame PC port built on the Himuro decompilation**](https://github.com/Mikompilation/MikuPan) - Ports the PS2 game Fatal Frame to native PC builds without emulation; its repository description names the Himuro decompilation as its basis. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/mikupan-fatal-frame-port-case/)</sub>
- [**Need for Speed: Most Wanted: rehosting the Android release on R36S**](https://github.com/Detoy/nfsmw-r36s) - The R36S port runs the 2012 Android release of Need for Speed: Most Wanted on ArkOS using the owner's game files. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/nfsmw-r36s-case/)</sub>
- [**NFS Most Wanted (2005): a Unity rebuild from speed.exe analysis**](https://github.com/MagicIbrar/nfsmw-unity) - NFS Most Wanted (2005) rebuilds the PC game's systems in Unity from function-by-function study of speed.exe and reads cars, world, audio and other content from the user's installation. <sub>Case study · Mixed workflow · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/nfsmw-unity-case/)</sub>
- [**OpenCrown PC: a native Dragon's Crown Pro host for console dumps**](https://github.com/Nezara/OpenCrown-PC) - OpenCrown PC runs Dragon's Crown Pro from a user-supplied decrypted PS4 or PS5 dump on Windows and Linux. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/opencrown-pc-case/)</sub>
- [**openmx: porting the MX Unleashed simulation to Rust**](https://github.com/FIZL0/openmx) - openmx ports the PlayStation 2 game MX Unleashed's riding simulation to Rust and supplies new desktop and browser presentation. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/openmx-case/)</sub>
- [**Paper Hexagon: a reconstructed Super Hexagon port for Linux and Playdate**](https://github.com/captn3m0/paperhexagon) - Paper Hexagon ports reconstructed Super Hexagon game code from the GOG Linux build to modern Linux and Playdate. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/paper-hexagon-super-hexagon-case/)</sub>
- [**PaperBoat: a native Paper Mario port built on the decompilation**](https://github.com/HarbourMasters/PaperBoat) - Compiles Paper Mario decompilation sources, credited to the pmret and Paper Mario DX projects, into a native US-version application on libultraship. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/paperboat-paper-mario-port-case/)</sub>
- [**Playcard Cosmic: a native port from executable analysis**](https://github.com/SiirGustav/playcard-cosmic-port) - Playcard Cosmic recreates the 2000 Windows shoot-'em-up in C++20 and SDL3 for Windows, Linux and macOS. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/playcard-cosmic-port-case/)</sub>
- [**Pokémon Platinum PC Port: a native port built on the pret decompilation**](https://github.com/cybervisi0n/pokeplatinum) - Builds native 64-bit Windows and Linux executables of Pokémon Platinum from a fork of pret’s decompilation, replacing NitroSDK with the author’s libntr libraries; the same tree keeps the DS ROM build and an experimental Switch target. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/pokemon-platinum-pc-port-case/)</sub>
- [**Pokémon X: native C reconstruction of game logic and field data**](https://github.com/chanadinh/pokemon-x-decomp) - Pokémon X reconstruction rebuilds selected Nintendo 3DS game logic and asset handling in portable C, with an SDL2 field slice for walking, dialogue and wild battles. <sub>Case study · Mixed workflow · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/pokemon-x-reconstruction-case/)</sub>
- [**Salamander UEFI: a disassembly-based UEFI port of the NES game**](https://github.com/MikeWuPing/UEFI_Salamander) - Salamander UEFI ports the NES game Salamander to a native UEFI Shell application by translating its 6502 disassembly into a platform-independent C core. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/salamander-uefi-case/)</sub>

- [**sm64ex: an enhanced Super Mario 64 PC port from the decompilation**](https://github.com/sm64pc/sm64ex) - Builds native Super Mario 64 executables from decompiled source, extending the sm64-port fork of the n64decomp reconstruction with renderer, input, camera, save-format and external-data options. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/sm64ex-pc-port-case/)</sub>
- [**SpaghettiKart: a native Mario Kart 64 port built on decompiled source**](https://github.com/HarbourMasters/SpaghettiKart) - Builds a native Mario Kart 64 port for Windows, Linux, macOS and Switch from source that keeps the Mario Kart 64 decompilation’s file layout, running on libultraship’s reimplemented N64 SDK. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/spaghettikart-mk64-port-case/)</sub>
- [**Starship: a Star Fox 64 PC port built from the decompilation**](https://github.com/HarbourMasters/Starship) - A native PC port of Star Fox 64 that compiles the game's decompiled C code against libultraship, an N64 porting library that reimplements libultra and renders through Fast3D. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/starship-sf64-pc-port-case/)</sub>
- [**Super Mario Sunshine: a native PC port from an AI-assisted decompilation**](https://github.com/chasem-dev/sms-pc-port) - Builds a native PC port of Super Mario Sunshine’s North American release from a pinned matching-decompilation fork, adding a host platform layer for graphics, disc, audio, input and OS services. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/sms-pc-port-case/)</sub>
- [**th06-headless: deterministic Touhou 6 logic runtime**](https://github.com/N0zoM1z0/th06-headless) - th06-headless adapts reconstructed Touhou 6 game logic into a deterministic Linux runtime for replay and learning research. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/th06-headless-case/)</sub>
- [**TH08 Web: a WebAssembly port built from reconstructed source**](https://github.com/N0zoM1z0/th08-web) - Compiles the reconstructed C++ source of the Japanese Touhou 8 1.00d release to WebAssembly with Emscripten, adding WebGL 2 rendering, Web Audio, browser input and IndexedDB saves behind the game’s D3D8-, DirectSound- and DirectInput-shaped interfaces. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/th08-web-wasm-port-case/)</sub>
- [**The Witcher 3: bounded native function recovery for ARM64**](https://github.com/slavich33/witcher-3-native-research) - The Witcher 3 native research recovers selected vector, VM, and decoder functions from The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt for ARM64 port experiments. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/witcher-3-native-research-case/)</sub>
- [**tmnt-recomp: porting the NES Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles game to C**](https://github.com/naparuba-retro/tmnt-recomp) - tmnt-recomp ports the 1989 NES Teenage Mutant Ninja Turtles game to C from analysis of its 6502 code. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/tmnt-recomp-case/)</sub>
- [**TonyWasAProSkater: a THPS1 native port forked from a matching decompilation**](https://github.com/LANCommander/TonyWasAProSkater) - Ports Tony Hawk’s Pro Skater (PlayStation, USA) to native Windows and Linux builds from a fork of an in-progress matching decompilation of the retail executable. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/thps1-decomp-native-port-case/)</sub>
- [**Touhou Reiiden: a C# port built around original PC-98 game data**](https://github.com/Felipe-Gomes-Amorim/touhou-reiiden-port) - Touhou Reiiden is a C# and .NET 8 port of the 1997 PC-98 game that loads assets from the user's own disk image or game folder. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/touhou-reiiden-port-case/)</sub>
- [**tp-vita: porting Twilight Princess to PS Vita**](https://github.com/Yannis100/tp-vita) - tp-vita ports Dusklight's GameCube Twilight Princess code to PS Vita by compiling the game and JSystem sources for ARM. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/tp-vita-case/)</sub>
- [**Vandal Hearts: native PC port built on matching decompilations**](https://github.com/HalmyLyseas/VandalHearts-PcPort) - Builds on shao113’s matching decompilation of PlayStation Vandal Hearts, adds a Japanese matching tree, and carries both through to a native Windows and Linux port. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/vandal-hearts-pc-port-case/)</sub>
- [**Zelda: The Wand of Gamelon: a Windows port of decompiled CD-i code**](https://github.com/ByteDecompiler/zelda-wand-of-gamelon-pc) - The Zelda: The Wand of Gamelon PC port runs the CD-i game's decompiled C code natively on Windows. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/zelda-wand-of-gamelon-pc-case/)</sub>

## Engine reimplementations

- [**AgainROM: a new engine for Rage of Mages**](https://github.com/againrom/againrom-engine) - AgainROM reimplements the Rage of Mages engine in Go to run the original campaign on Windows, macOS and Linux. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/againrom-rage-of-mages-case/)</sub>
- [**Age of Empires Free Software Remake: a re-implementation on the original data**](https://github.com/FolkertVanVerseveld/aoe) - Re-implements Microsoft’s Age of Empires and its Rise of Rome expansion as a cross-platform C++17 engine on SDL2 and OpenGL that loads the original game’s DRS archives and language.dll resources. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/aoe-free-software-remake-case/)</sub>
- [**Angry Birds PC engine: reimplementing the game engine from executable analysis**](https://github.com/BurnerAccount-dec/linnut1.6.2-decomp) - Angry Birds PC engine reimplements the game's native engine in C++ from analysis of the 1.6.2 executable. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/angry-birds-pc-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**Battalion Wars 2: a Rust and Bevy engine reconstruction**](https://github.com/bcain2121/battalion-wars-2-rust-decomp) - Battalion Wars 2 is reconstructed as a native Rust and Bevy engine that loads archives, models, terrain, audio and Lua 5.0 mission bytecode from a user-supplied Wii disc image. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/battalion-wars-2-rust-decomp-case/)</sub>
- [**Bravo: a reverse-engineered Minecraft server**](https://github.com/bravoserver/bravo) - Reimplements the server side of Minecraft’s Alpha- and Beta-era multiplayer in Python on Twisted; its documentation calls it a reverse-engineered implementation written from scratch, credits network traffic dumps and says general Minecraft data went to a community wiki. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/bravo-minecraft-server-case/)</sub>
- [**Brickwork: a DX-Ball-inspired browser game from REA and Ghidra findings**](https://github.com/alxmtzr/brickwork) - Brickwork is a browser brick-breaker reconstructed from the author's REA and Ghidra study of DX-Ball's Windows executable and asset formats. <sub>Case study · Mixed workflow · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/brickwork-case/)</sub>
- [**Bully Decompiled: an Unreal reconstruction of Bully: Scholarship Edition**](https://github.com/HunterStile/Rea_Bully) - Rea Bully studies Bully: Scholarship Edition's executable, Lua 5.0 scripts, and asset formats with REA, Ghidra, and local recovery tools, then builds an Unreal Engine 5.8 exploration runtime from those findings. <sub>Case study · Mixed workflow · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/rea-bully-case/)</sub>
- [**Chariot: Age of Empires engine reimplementation**](https://github.com/ChariotEngine/Chariot) - Chariot is an open-source effort to reimplement the engine of the original Age of Empires (1997). <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/chariot/)</sub>
- [**Chicken Invaders 1: rebuilding the 1999 game**](https://github.com/LockBlock-dev/chicken-invaders) - Chicken Invaders 1 rebuilds the original 1999 game in C++ with a separate UveDX engine layer. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/chicken-invaders-1-case/)</sub>
- [**CoD4 Rewrite: Rust/Bevy reconstruction**](https://github.com/Nilbong/COD4-Rewrite) - A Rust/Bevy reconstruction of Call of Duty 4 multiplayer systems, using assets from a local game installation. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/cod4-rewrite-reconstruction-case/)</sub>
- [**CorsixTH: an open reimplementation of Theme Hospital**](https://github.com/CorsixTH/CorsixTH) - Reimplements the engine of Bullfrog’s 1997 Theme Hospital, with game logic in Lua and C++ for graphics, sound, movies and pathfinding, on top of the original game’s data files. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/corsixth-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**Cursed Lands: a Godot engine for Evil Islands and Lost in Astral**](https://github.com/TheWWWorm/CursedLands) - Cursed Lands reimplements the engine for Evil Islands and Lost in Astral in Godot, reading maps, models, audio, scripts and tables from the player's own game copy. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/cursed-lands-case/)</sub>
- [**cyrus: rebuilding The Elder Scrolls Adventures: Redguard in Rust and Bevy**](https://github.com/michidk/cyrus) - cyrus rebuilds The Elder Scrolls Adventures: Redguard in Rust and Bevy using files from a local GOG installation. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/cyrus-redguard-case/)</sub>
- [**Desktop Games Nostalgia: a macOS and browser port**](https://github.com/ucodia/desktop-games-nostalgia) - A Swift/macOS and JavaScript/browser port recreates the Desktop Games screen-smashing toy from a captured image. <sub>Case study · Mixed workflow · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/desktop-games-nostalgia-rea-port-case/)</sub>
- [**dreamREfactory: rebuilding CyberFlix's DreamFactory engine**](https://github.com/dhobi/dreamrefactory) - dreamREfactory rebuilds CyberFlix's DreamFactory game engine in TypeScript for browser play using the owner's game data. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/dreamrefactory-case/)</sub>
- [**DW3 Remake: reimplementing Digimon World 2003**](https://github.com/antharuu/dw3-remake) - DW3 Remake reimplements the PlayStation game Digimon World 2003 in Godot 4 and C#. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/dw3-remake-case/)</sub>

- [**Firestaff: rebuilding the Dungeon Master game engines**](https://github.com/yeager/firestaff) - Firestaff rebuilds runtime paths for Dungeon Master, Chaos Strikes Back, Dungeon Master II and Theron's Quest using original media supplied by the player. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/firestaff-dungeon-master-case/)</sub>

- [**Galaxian2: reimplementing Galaxy on Fire 2 in Godot**](https://github.com/TheWWWorm/galaxian2) - Galaxian2 reimplements Galaxy on Fire 2 as a Godot engine using content imported from the player's Mac Full HD or Android HD release. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/galaxian2-gof2-case/)</sub>
- [**Galaxian: reimplementing Galaxy on Fire 1 for Godot**](https://github.com/TheWWWorm/galaxian) - Galaxian reimplements the iPhone edition of Galaxy on Fire 1 as a Godot engine. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/galaxian-gof1-case/)</sub>

- [**h4r: rebuilding the Heroes of Might and Magic IV engine**](https://github.com/demen1n/h4r) - h4r reimplements the Heroes of Might and Magic IV engine in Rust using data from a player's installation. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/h4r-case/)</sub>
- [**Hexwaste: reimplementing a slice of the Fallout 2 engine**](https://github.com/eko1495/HexWaste) - Hexwaste reimplements part of the Fallout 2 engine in C# and MonoGame using files from the user's own installation. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/hexwaste-case/)</sub>
- [**HL2-RS: a partial Rust reconstruction of Half-Life 2**](https://github.com/kvalls/hl2-rs) - HL2-RS partially reconstructs Half-Life 2 in Rust and Bevy, reading maps, models, textures, animations, and sounds from an installed copy. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/hl2-rs-case/)</sub>
- [**Horizon: a Rust rewrite of Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 with REA bytecode queries**](https://github.com/ludovic111/horizon) - Rewrites Minecraft: Java Edition 26.3 as a native Rust client, dedicated server and launcher that prepare their resources from the user’s own copy of the game. <sub>Case study · Mixed workflow · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/horizon-minecraft-rust-rewrite-case/)</sub>
- [**HotaSim: reconstructing Horn of the Abyss battle mechanics**](https://github.com/patrulek/hotasim) - HotaSim reimplements selected Heroes III: Horn of the Abyss battle mechanics in C++ and uses them in a battle simulator. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/hotasim-case/)</sub>
- [**impacto: a reimplementation of the MAGES. visual-novel engine**](https://github.com/CommitteeOfZero/impacto) - Reimplements the MAGES. visual-novel engine, used by the Science Adventure and Memories Off series, in C++ with OpenGL, running supported titles from the user’s original data files through per-game Lua profiles in one binary. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/impacto-mages-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**Irisu ML: reconstructing Irisu Syndrome! normal mode**](https://github.com/Gabriel-Kahen/irisu-ml) - Irisu ML reconstructs Irisu Syndrome! v2.03 normal mode as a deterministic C++20 simulator, Python learning environment and playable browser client. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/irisu-ml-case/)</sub>
- [**IW4L: a Rust runtime that plays Modern Warfare 2 from the user’s installed game**](https://github.com/vladtrc/iw4L) - Implements a standalone runtime for Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 2 (2009) in Rust on Bevy and wgpu, loading maps, models, textures and weapons from the user’s installed game through native FastFile readers and translating its Direct3D 9 shaders to WGSL. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/iw4l-mw2-rust-runtime-case/)</sub>
- [**Jazz² Resurrection: a native C++ reimplementation of Jazz Jackrabbit 2**](https://github.com/deathkiller/jazz2-native) - Reimplements Jazz Jackrabbit 2 (1998) as a native C++ game on an extensively modified nCine engine, converting the user’s original game files into its own cache on first start. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/jazz2-resurrection-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**Kinoko: reimplementing Mario Kart Wii’s physics engine for exact ghost replay**](https://github.com/vabold/Kinoko) - Re-implements Mario Kart Wii’s physics engine in C++ as a command-line simulator, continuing stblr/Hanachan’s goal of perfectly accurate time-trial ghost replay. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/kinoko-mkwii-physics-reimplementation-case/)</sub>

- [**Legend of Legaia: a Rust port with disc-local browser tooling**](https://github.com/AndrewAltimit/legend-of-legaia-re) - A from-scratch Rust port of the North American PlayStation Legend of Legaia includes native/browser play, asset extraction and disc patching. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/legend-of-legaia-rust-port-case/)</sub>
