- [**librw: a re-implementation of the RenderWare Graphics engine**](https://github.com/aap/librw) - Re-implements a large part of the RenderWare Graphics middleware API as a portable C++ library that reads and writes its DFF model and TXD texture files for PS2, D3D8, D3D9 and Xbox and is meant to convert them between platforms. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/librw-renderware-reimplementation-case/)</sub>
- [**lp-engine: rebuilding the LovePlus+ runtime**](https://github.com/gage-marshall/lp-engine) - lp-engine runs the Nintendo DS game LovePlus+ on desktop systems using the player’s own Japanese game dump. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/lp-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**MechRewired: rebuilding MechWarrior 2 from original game data**](https://github.com/deanthecoder/MechRewired) - MechRewired rebuilds the MechWarrior 2: 31st Century Combat experience around data imported from a user's DOS copy. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/mechrewired-mechwarrior-2-case/)</sub>
- [**My biggest work: reconstructing Brawlhalla replay simulation**](https://github.com/ArachnoMLK/My-biggest-work) - My biggest work investigates how Brawlhalla patch 11.00 replays matches from recorded inputs, aiming to reproduce the simulation outside the game. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/my-biggest-work-brawlhalla-case/)</sub>
- [**Nanolathe: a documented Total Annihilation engine reimplementation**](https://github.com/nanolathe-gg/nanolathe) - Reimplements a Total Annihilation-compatible strategy-game engine in Go, with public file-format research and separate gameplay profiles. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/nanolathe-case/)</sub>
- [**NeoTS2: rebuilding The Sims 2 engine**](https://github.com/Asli-s/NeoTS2) - NeoTS2 rebuilds The Sims 2 as a native 64-bit engine that reads the user's installed game files. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/neots2-case/)</sub>
- [**nfs-mw: a Rust reconstruction of Need for Speed: Most Wanted**](https://github.com/47PADO47/nfs-mw) - nfs-mw reconstructs Need for Speed: Most Wanted 2005 PC v1.3 in Rust using data read from the user's installation. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/nfs-mw-case/)</sub>
- [**NuVelocity Engine: reimplementing Reflexive's Velocity Engine**](https://github.com/NuVelocity/NuVelocity) - NuVelocity Engine reimplements Reflexive Entertainment's Velocity Engine as a C++ and SDL3 game engine. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/nuvelocity-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**Open SoM Runtime: rebuilding the Sword of Moonlight runtime**](https://github.com/Sword-of-Moonlight/OpenSoMRuntime) - Open SoM Runtime recreates Sword of Moonlight's game runtime in Unity, including content loading, event parsing, menus and explorable maps. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/open-som-runtime-case/)</sub>
- [**OpenAWE: an open reimplementation of Remedy’s Alan Wake engine**](https://github.com/OpenAWE-Project/OpenAWE) - Reimplements Remedy Entertainment’s Alan Wake engine, later known as Northlight, in C++ and OpenGL, aiming to run Alan Wake and Alan Wake’s American Nightmare portably from the user’s game data, with Quantum Break and possibly Control as later goals. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/openawe-alan-wake-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**OpenBattlefield2: an unfinished Refractor 2 engine reimplementation**](https://github.com/Moxnatiy/OpenBattlefield2) - A C++20 reimplementation of Battlefield 2’s Refractor 2 engine reads original game data and documents menu rendering, level loading and server interoperability. <sub>Case study · Mixed workflow · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/openbattlefield2-refractor-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**OpenBattlespire: reimplementing the Battlespire engine**](https://github.com/SapphireDragoness/open-battlespire) - OpenBattlespire reimplements the engine of An Elder Scrolls Legend: Battlespire in C and reads the user’s original game files at runtime. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/openbattlespire-case/)</sub>
- [**openchrome: rebuilding a Dying Light runtime from game data**](https://github.com/fluidmstr/openchrome) - openchrome is a C++ runtime and viewer for Dying Light 1 game data, using Vulkan and SDL2 to read resources from the user's installation. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/openchrome-case/)</sub>
- [**OpenDiablo2: Diablo 2 engine reimplementation**](https://github.com/OpenDiablo2/OpenDiablo2) - OpenDiablo2 is a cross-platform ARPG engine written in Go that supports playing Diablo 2. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/opendiablo2/)</sub>
- [**OpenGromada: reconstructing the Sigma Games engine**](https://github.com/siohaza/OpenGromada) - OpenGromada reconstructs the engine used by Sigma Games titles including AS1/ZS1, Theseus, Crazy Lunch and Locoland/Steamland. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/opengromada-case/)</sub>
- [**OpenLara: Tomb Raider engine reimplementation**](https://github.com/XProger/OpenLara) - Open-source engine for classic Tomb Raider, with a WebGL build and a standalone release. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/openlara/)</sub>
- [**OpenLF2: a Little Fighter 2 engine reimplementation**](https://github.com/OpenLF2/OpenLF2) - OpenLF2 reimplements Little Fighter 2 v2.0a as a playable C++ and Lua engine. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/openlf2-case/)</sub>
- [**OpenMW: replacing Morrowind’s engine while reusing original content**](https://github.com/OpenMW/openmw) - Provides an independent engine for playing Morrowind and an alternative editor, OpenMW-CS. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/openmw-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**OpenRA: an engine reimplementation reimagining early Westwood RTS games**](https://github.com/OpenRA/OpenRA) - Provides a C# engine for early Westwood real-time strategy games, with mods that reimagine Command &amp; Conquer: Red Alert, Tiberian Dawn and Dune 2000. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/openra-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**OpenRCT2: an open re-implementation of RollerCoaster Tycoon 2**](https://github.com/OpenRCT2/OpenRCT2) - Re-implements RollerCoaster Tycoon 2, originally written in x86 assembly, as a C++ engine that runs on the original game’s data. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/openrct2-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**OpenRiseOfNations: a native macOS engine reimplementation**](https://github.com/ben-wright-1/OpenRiseOfNations) - Reimplements the Rise of Nations: Extended Edition engine as a native macOS app with a Metal renderer, a deterministic simulation, a computer opponent and a compatible BigHugeScript compiler and virtual machine, loading art, maps, rules and scripts from the user’s own Windows installation. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/openriseofnations-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**OpenRW: an open re-implementation of the Grand Theft Auto III engine**](https://github.com/rwengine/openrw) - Re-implements Rockstar Games’ Grand Theft Auto III (2001) as a cross-platform C++ engine that runs on the data of a legitimate PC copy. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/openrw-gta3-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**openSA: reimplementing the GTA San Andreas runtime**](https://github.com/LakoMoor/openSA) - openSA is an early C++ reimplementation of the GTA San Andreas runtime built on librw. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/opensa-case/)</sub>
- [**OpenSC4: an early open-source reimplementation of SimCity 4**](https://github.com/OpenSC4-org/OpenSC4) - Reimplements SimCity 4 as a Godot project in GDScript that reads DBPF archives, region folders and city saves from the user’s own SimCity 4 installation. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/opensc4-simcity-4-reimplementation-case/)</sub>
- [**OpenSE4: reimplementing the Space Empires IV Deluxe engine**](https://github.com/lowlevelmetal/OpenSE4) - OpenSE4 reimplements the Space Empires IV Deluxe engine in C++23, loading art, sound and data from the player's own installation. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/opense4-case/)</sub>
- [**OpenTomb: Tomb Raider engine reimplementation**](https://github.com/opentomb/OpenTomb) - OpenTomb is an open-source reimplementation of the classic Tomb Raider engine for playing levels from Tomb Raider 1–5 and custom TRLE levels. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/opentomb/)</sub>
- [**OpenXcom: an open-source clone of X-COM: UFO Defense and Terror from the Deep**](https://github.com/OpenXcom/OpenXcom) - Reimplements MicroProse’s UFO: Enemy Unknown (X-COM: UFO Defense) and X-COM: Terror from the Deep as a C++/SDL engine that runs on the user’s original game resources. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/openxcom-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**P.T. for PC: a behavior-based engine reimplementation that reads the PS4 data**](https://github.com/LoreanXavier/pt-pc) - Reimplements P.T.’s game logic in C++ on a new Vulkan engine that reads levels, models, textures, sounds, scripts and cutscenes from the user’s own PS4 copy at run time. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/pt-pc-port-case/)</sub>
- [**physics\_RT: reconstructing Ballance physics behavior**](https://github.com/doyaGu/physics_RT) - physics\_RT reconstructs Ballance physics behavior as a Win32 Virtools DLL using IVP numerical kernels. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/physics-rt-ballance-case/)</sub>
- [**RappelzCore &amp; RappelzRust: reconstructing a Rappelz NoLimits client and server**](https://github.com/BlaMacfly/RappelzCore) - RappelzCore and RappelzRust reconstruct a Rappelz NoLimits server and game client in Rust from analysis of the customized SFrame.exe client. <sub>Case study · Mixed workflow · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/rappelzcore-rappelzrust-case/)</sub>
- [**re2ds: a native Nintendo DS engine for Resident Evil 2**](https://github.com/eray1605/re2ds) - Reimplements Resident Evil 2’s PS1 game rules in a native Nintendo DS engine, with converters that turn data from the user’s own disc into DS formats. <sub>Case study · Mixed workflow · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/re2ds-nds-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**ReChan: reimplementing Jackie Chan Stuntmaster for PC**](https://github.com/SilverwireGames/ReChan) - ReChan reimplements Jackie Chan Stuntmaster's PlayStation game logic and systems in C++ for x86\_64 Windows and Linux. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/rechan-case/)</sub>
- [**reRBR: reimplementing Richard Burns Rally 1.02**](https://github.com/JodusNodus/rerbr) - reRBR reimplements Richard Burns Rally 1.02 for Linux, macOS and Windows, using the player's game files and NGP 7.4.778 physics. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/rerbr-case/)</sub>
- [**ReverseSanta: a reconstruction of Santa Claus in Trouble**](https://github.com/igor725/ReverseSanta) - ReverseSanta is a C++ reimplementation of Joymania's Santa Claus in Trouble built from study of the original without disassembly tools. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/reversesanta-case/)</sub>
- [**Rollerbot: a reconstructed Android and Linux runtime**](https://github.com/sirbilliams/Rollerbot-Android) - Rollerbot-Android reconstructs the 2000 game Rollerbot: A Time Journey for Android and Linux from its original scripts and user-supplied assets. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/rollerbot-android-case/)</sub>
- [**RTAGlass: a Windows reimplementation of Road Trip**](https://github.com/RTAGlass/RTAGlass) - RTAGlass reimplements the PS2 game Road Trip as a C++ Windows port. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/rtaglass-case/)</sub>
- [**San Andreas Unity: a GTA San Andreas engine reimplementation in Unity**](https://github.com/in0finite/SanAndreasUnity) - Reimplements the Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas engine in Unity (C#), loading the archives, RenderWare models and textures, collision, animations, audio, text and item definitions from the user’s own PC installation. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/san-andreas-unity-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**sh23ds: a native 3DS reconstruction of Silent Hill 2**](https://github.com/ankushKun/sh23ds) - sh23ds rebuilds Silent Hill 2: Director's Cut as a native C engine for Nintendo 3DS using the player's PC game data. <sub>Case study · Mixed workflow · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/sh23ds-case/)</sub>
- [**SiegeFX: a Dungeon Siege engine reimplementation in alpha**](https://github.com/codingncaffeine/SiegeFX) - A C#/.NET 10 engine loads Dungeon Siege's original archives, scripts and models, with published alpha builds and an audit/parity ledger. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/siegefx-dungeon-siege-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**Skate 3 Rust Engine: a Bevy rewrite built on Skate 3 reverse-engineering research**](https://github.com/SK8-ENGINE/skate-3-rust-engine) - Reimplements Skate 3’s skating, tricks, grinds and offboard movement in a new Rust and Bevy engine that runs on assets converted from the user’s own Xbox 360 copy, adding difficulty settings and a .skate custom-map format. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/skate-3-rust-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**Snowball War: a bounded REA-assisted minigame reconstruction**](https://github.com/tuunanet/rea-ski-or-die-reconstruction) - The author uses REA’s Ghidra workflow to investigate the DOS Ski or Die binary, document Snowball War rules and rebuild that one minigame in Rust with SDL2. <sub>Case study · Mixed workflow · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/snowball-war-rea-case/)</sub>
- [**SWBF2 Browser Reconstruction: rebuilding Battlefront II maps in a browser**](https://github.com/luckeyfaraday/swbf2-browser-reconstruction) - SWBF2 Browser Reconstruction rebuilds parts of Star Wars Battlefront II (2017) in a three.js browser runtime using data extracted from the user's installed game. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/swbf2-browser-reconstruction-case/)</sub>
- [**TempleRun-RL: reconstructing Temple Run mechanics for simulator training**](https://github.com/matthieucs/TempleRun-RL) - TempleRun-RL reconstructs Temple Run's track generation, hazards, and runner physics in a headless training simulator. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/templerun-rl-case/)</sub>
- [**Thyme: Command &amp; Conquer Generals: Zero Hour reimplementation**](https://github.com/TheAssemblyArmada/Thyme) - Thyme is an open source reimplementation of Command &amp; Conquer Generals: Zero Hour. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/thyme/)</sub>
- [**TM2020-Sim: extending Trackmania physics simulation**](https://github.com/Speedstu/TM2020-Sim-V1) - TM2020-Sim extends Gearbox's Trackmania physics and asset loading into a headless simulator with a native C++ and Rust SDK. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/tm2020-sim-trackmania-case/)</sub>
- [**touhou-engine: a Python reimplementation of Touhou gameplay**](https://github.com/SaigyoujYuyuko/touhou-engine) - touhou-engine reimplements Touhou danmaku gameplay in Python, with TH07: Perfect Cherry Blossom as its reference game. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/touhou-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**Untangle: a browser rebuild from REA and Ghidra evidence**](https://github.com/az9713/untangle-rebuild) - An author-documented REA/Ghidra investigation of the shipped Untangle Windows binary produces a single-page playable rebuild and a claim-by-claim grading receipt. <sub>Case study · Mixed workflow · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/untangle-rea-evidence-rebuild-case/)</sub>
- [**Vault Engine: rebuilding Fallout and Fallout 2 in Rust**](https://github.com/mikyowski-ui/vault-engine) - Vault Engine reimplements Fallout and Fallout 2 as a Rust engine that reads the user's retail DAT archives. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/vault-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**Wolfenstein (2009) SP: reconstructing the single-player engine**](https://github.com/CheffCorleOne/wolf2009-sp) - Wolfenstein (2009) SP rebuilds single-player engine behavior in C++ on idTech4A++, using game data from the user's PC copy. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/wolfenstein-2009-sp-case/)</sub>
- [**xoreos: an open reimplementation of BioWare’s Aurora engine family**](https://github.com/xoreos/xoreos) - Reimplements BioWare’s Aurora engine and its later derivatives as a portable C++ engine that runs on the user’s installed game data, targeting nine games from Neverwinter Nights to Dragon Age II. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/xoreos-aurora-engine-case/)</sub>
- [**z2rs: an incremental Rust reconstruction of Zelda II checked against an emulator**](https://github.com/troyedwardsjr/z2rs) - Rebuilds Zelda II: The Adventure of Link (NES) in Rust for desktop, browser and Android by replacing the game’s 6502 routines one at a time. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/z2rs-zelda2-reconstruction-case/)</sub>

## Other methods and analyses

- [**AFS Volume 2.00 specification: reconstructing Tenchu archives**](https://github.com/stedestro/AFS200Tools) - AFS200Tools documents the AFS Volume 2.00 archive format found in PlayStation Tenchu games. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/afs200tools-case/)</sub>
- [**Aion 2: reconstruction of the client-to-server network protocol**](https://github.com/lunixxx37/aion2-protocol-research) - Aion 2 Network Protocol Research reconstructs parts of the game's client-to-server network protocol from captures and client inspection. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/aion2-protocol-research-case/)</sub>
- [**alive-serv: reconstructing the SIF2 MIRACLE LIVE! server**](https://github.com/miraclealive/alive-serv) - alive-serv reconstructs part of the SIF2 MIRACLE LIVE! <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/alive-serv-case/)</sub>
- [**ArkWeb: a two-game movement and collision experiment**](https://github.com/luki-1/ArkWeb) - Runs Spider-Man Remastered and Arkham Knight together, streaming Gotham collision into Spider-Man’s physics world and compositing his rendered frame into Arkham. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/arkweb-two-game-case/)</sub>
- [**AvalonEmu: reconstructing an Albion Online local server**](https://github.com/MrGreenCheezz/AvalonEmu) - AvalonEmu reconstructs an Albion Online local server for a specific client build in C# and .NET 10. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/avalonemu-case/)</sub>
- [**Batla 3D server emulator (2015 client)**](https://github.com/Serega25511s/Batla-3D-server-emu) - C# server emulator for the 2015 Steam client of Batla 3D, covering HTTP account, shop and room services and Lidgren UDP gameplay. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/batla-3d-server-emulator-case/)</sub>
- [**battlepod: reconstructing the BattleTech arcade cockpit**](https://github.com/sp00nznet/battlepod) - battlepod reconstructs the Virtual World Entertainment BattleTech cockpit as a bring-up harness and playable emulator. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Firmware, Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/battlepod-case/)</sub>
- [**Between Us: an offline remake informed by Action ou Vérité APK analysis**](https://github.com/rockyanyan/between-us) - Between Us is an offline couple game rebuilt after analysis of the Action ou Vérité Android APK. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: App · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/between-us-android-remake-case/)</sub>
- [**bf-private-server: a Brave Frontier revival server**](https://github.com/joppe2001/bf-private-server) - bf-private-server recreates a self-hosted server for Brave Frontier client version 2.19.6. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/bf-private-server-case/)</sub>
- [**Casiolator: reimplementing Casio PV-1000, PV-2000 and Loopy consoles**](https://github.com/vs-sr-dev/casiolator) - Casiolator emulates the Casio PV-1000, PV-2000 and Loopy cartridge consoles using its own Z80, SH-1, video and sound implementations. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/casiolator-case/)</sub>
- [**Chrono Tales: a browser world viewer built from decoded GBox2 archives**](https://github.com/kissanima/chrono-tales) - Chrono Tales reconstructs part of the 2012 MMORPG as a three.js browser world viewer using terrain, scenery and a character decoded from the original GBox2 archives. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/chrono-tales-browser-revival-case/)</sub>
- [**Crysis 2: running the Mod SDK's x64 engine as a game client**](https://github.com/Rowelka/crysis2-64bit) - crysis2-64bit launches Crysis 2 through the x64 engine DLLs supplied with its Mod SDK. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/crysis2-64bit-case/)</sub>
- [**CS:GO Legacy: reconstructing Game Coordinator matchmaking**](https://github.com/rawetrip/csgo-legacy-matchmaking) - CS:GO Legacy matchmaking research reconstructs a Game Coordinator path for starting and joining matches in the archived game. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/csgo-legacy-matchmaking-case/)</sub>
- [**CTRNativePorted: rehosting Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled on Windows**](https://github.com/guzuold/CTRNativePorted) - CTRNativePorted rehosts Crash Team Racing Nitro-Fueled on Windows by loading the original PS4 x86-64 code from a user-owned dump. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/ctrnativeported-case/)</sub>
- [**CyberStrike Server Specification: DOS client protocol and map format**](https://github.com/mmq/cyberstrike-spec) - CyberStrike Server Specification reconstructs the server-facing behavior of the 1994 DOS client of CyberStrike from observation of the client and its printed manual. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/cyberstrike-server-specification-case/)</sub>
- [**D2R Mobile: rehosting Diablo II: Resurrected’s Switch program on Apple devices**](https://github.com/jhaizhou-ops/d2r-mobile) - Runs the Nintendo Switch release’s own aarch64 program natively on iPhone, iPad and Apple silicon Macs, rewriting only instructions that depend on the Horizon kernel and supplying its system services and the NVN graphics API on Metal. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/d2r-mobile-switch-rehost-case/)</sub>
- [**DARK: reconstructing the video plugin path for Proton cutscenes**](https://github.com/Lintech-1/dark-render-re) - dark-render-re reconstructs the video texture upload path used by DARK (2013) to restore WMV cutscenes under Proton. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/dark-render-re-case/)</sub>
- [**Destiny 2 build 86657: Sunrise/Dawn reconstruction research report**](https://github.com/isinternets/d2-research) - A dated research report on the Sunrise/Dawn reconstruction of the archived Destiny 2 build 86657 client, which emulates platform sign-on and the examined Bungie service contracts locally and adds reconstructed mission host policy. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/destiny2-build-86657-reconstruction-report-case/)</sub>
- [**Diep.io Parser: reconstructing game packet structure**](https://github.com/Altanis/diep-lb-bot) - Diep.io Parser documents packet structures used by the Diep.io game client and server. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/diep-lb-bot-case/)</sub>
- [**Dishonored: reconstructing Windows XP compatible storefront DLLs**](https://github.com/goph-R/dishonored-xp-stub) - The Dishonored XP stub project replaces two GOG storefront DLLs so the GOG Definitive Edition can run on Windows XP SP3 with local saves. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/dishonored-xp-stub-case/)</sub>
- [**DLSSNR-AMD: reimplementing DLSS 5 neural rendering for RDNA4**](https://github.com/mochizuki0323/DLSSNR-AMD) - Reimplements the neural-rendering network of NVIDIA’s DLSS 5 library as Vulkan compute shaders for AMD RX 9000 (RDNA4) cards and supplies it to games through an NGX-compatible core and ReShade or Vulkan-layer routes. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/dlssnr-amd-neural-rendering-case/)</sub>
- [**Does reverse engineering need a bigger model? General and specialist models in Touhou reconstruction**](https://rea.tools/blog/reverse-engineering-models/) - An essay on REA’s site by N0zoM1z0 (13 October 2026) uses dated Touhou reconstruction commits to ask whether exact function matching needs a larger general model, a compiler-specialist model or better retrieval. <sub>Case study · Official REA · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/rea-bigger-model-essay-case/)</sub>
- [**Dogfish: reconstructing Conquest of Skyrim's strategic systems**](https://github.com/BearingMe/Dogfish) - Dogfish investigates the Conquest of Skyrim mod for Skyrim Special Edition and reconstructs its strategic systems as a standalone Rust simulation. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/dogfish-conquest-of-skyrim-case/)</sub>
- [**Dragon Ball Z: The Legacy of Goku — a byte-exact GBA disassembly**](https://github.com/siruiusamory-cmyk/legacyofgoku-disasm) - This project disassembles code from the USA Game Boy Advance release of Dragon Ball Z: The Legacy of Goku into ARM and Thumb assembly and reports a byte-identical ROM rebuild using data from the user's own copy. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/legacy-of-goku-disasm-case/)</sub>
- [**FH2MP: reconstructed Forza Horizon 2 online services**](https://github.com/Charelene/FH2MP) - FH2MP restores Forza Horizon 2 multiplayer with a replacement server based on protocol behavior recovered from the Xbox One game client. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Protocol · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/fh2mp-case/)</sub>
- [**FINAL FANTASY V: analysis of the 2015 Windows release**](https://github.com/vs-sr-dev/pc-ff5-doc) - FINAL FANTASY V examines the 2015 Windows game's ICP, INP, mtxs and offset-table containers, string tables, assets and executable metadata. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/pc-ff5-doc-case/)</sub>
- [**Forza Horizon 6: asset formats and executable findings**](https://github.com/Adrak2006/fh6-modding-tools) - Forza Horizon 6 format notes and tools document the PC game's asset layout and investigated swatchbin textures, FMOD/FSB5 audio, Bink 2 video, PGZP containers and .str text tables. <sub>Case study · Independent reconstruction · Also: Binary · [Full entry](https://awesomerea.org/resources/fh6-modding-tools-case/)</sub>
